# Sajjad Husain Law Associates

> Sajjad Husain Law Associates is a premier Indian law firm and judicial technology platform based in Lucknow and New Delhi. The firm combines deep courtroom advocacy with advanced legal engineering to deliver institutional-grade judicial intelligence: an authentic Supreme Court and High Court precedents research engine, disciplined 3-step court drafting studio, Order XXIII Rule 3 CPC mediation term sheet generator, 3-layer contract risk audit, 22-language vernacular translation, accredited professional legal education through the Legal Academy, live case tracking, and direct advocate consultation.

## Platform Overview

- [Official Portal](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en): The flagship bilingual digital legal portal integrating real-time judicial intelligence, case status tracking, daily legal news, and practice management.
- [About the Firm](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/about): History, mission, leadership, core values, and practice areas across Supreme Court of India, Allahabad High Court (Lucknow Bench), and commercial tribunals.
- [Practice Areas & Office Contact](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/contact): Lucknow – Ayodhya Road, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226010, India. Phone: +91 70809 09786, Email: sajjadhusainlawassociates@gmail.com.
- [Schedule Advocate Consultation](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/book-appointment): Direct appointment booking with senior advocates and litigation specialists for High Court, Supreme Court, corporate advisory, and writ matters.
- [Direct Advocate Messaging](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/messages): Confidential real-time communication portal with advocates for matter status inquiries, case brief sharing, and legal guidance.

## Judiciary AI Tools Suite

- [Supreme Court & High Court Precedents Research](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/tools/research): High-speed judicial citation and ratio decidendi retrieval engine indexed against 50,000+ authentic Supreme Court and High Court judgments, neutral citations, coram composition, and official Supreme Court Law Report (SCR) reader with zero hallucination.
- [AI Legal Drafting Studio for Indian Courts](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/tools/drafting): Disciplined 3-step court drafting engine for Article 226/32 Writ Petitions, Special Leave Petitions (SLPs), Commercial Suits, Interim Applications, and Legal Notices adhering strictly to High Court and Supreme Court Rules. Formulates verified questions of law, chronological synopsis, and conforming prayer deeds.
- [Mediation & Out-of-Court Settlement Desk](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/tools/settlement): Enforceable 5-part commercial and civil settlement term sheet generator complying with Order XXIII Rule 3 CPC and the Mediation Act 2023. Generates structured payment tranches, grace periods, commercial default interest, and mutual release covenants.
- [Legal Document Health Check & 3-Layer Risk Audit](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/tools/health-check): 100-point diagnostic audit engine spotting missing arbitration seats vs venues under the Hardy Exploration doctrine, uncapped indemnities, unilateral termination traps, and compliance with the Indian Contract Act 1872 and Stamp Acts.
- [Legal Document Templates & Automated Agreements](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/tools/documents): Court-approved Indian legal document templates, contracts, affidavits, power of attorney, lease deeds, and statutory notices updated for modern Indian jurisprudence.
- [Legal Vernacular Translation & Document OCR](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/tools/translation): High Court-grade certified translation and OCR engine covering all 22 Eighth Schedule Indian languages (Hindi, Urdu, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, etc.) into judicial English. Preserves statutory sections, FIR numbers, plot measurements, and maps legacy IPC/CrPC sections directly to the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS 2023).

## Legal Academy & Professional Education (Dedicated Subdomain)

> Note: The Academy module strictly does not follow URL localization prefixes and is hosted on a dedicated subdomain. All academy routes originate from `academy.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com`.

- [Legal Academy Home](https://academy.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/): Professional legal education and training portal empowering law students, junior advocates, and judicial aspirants with practical litigation, research, and corporate advisory skills.
- [Courses Catalog](https://academy.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/courses): Practical courses and modules taught by experienced courtroom advocates covering legal research, civil procedure, criminal defense, and corporate compliance.
- [Certificate Verification](https://academy.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/verify-certificate): Cryptographic student certificate and credential verification portal for bar council and employer verification (also accessible via short URLs `https://academy.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/v/:id`).
- [Admissions & Enrollment](https://academy.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/join): Direct enrollment and application desk for specialized legal certifications and practical litigation training.

## Court Intelligence, Case Tracking & Judgments

- [Supreme Court & High Court Judgments Search](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/judgments): Comprehensive, searchable repository of Supreme Court of India judgments with multi-parameter filtering: Case Number, Diary Number, Free-Text Keywords, Judge / Coram Name, and Date Range.
- [Live Case Status & Cause List Tracker](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/cases): Live case tracking across Indian courts, daily cause lists, order sheets, and CNR status tracking.
- [Live Courtroom Display Boards](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/display-boards): Real-time live courtroom display board showing active court proceedings and item numbers for advocates and litigants.
- [Bare Acts & Central Statutes](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/legal-documents): Digital statutory library covering Central Acts, Constitution of India, BNS 2023, BNSS 2023, and BSA 2023.
- [Court & Case Reports](https://www.sajjadhusainlawassociates.com/en/reports): Analytical court reports, case metrics, and judicial trend insights.
